name: llguidance
summary: High-performance structured-output / constrained-decoding engine from the Guidance project (Rust core, Python bindings).
description: MIT-licensed structured-output engine (guidance-ai/llguidance; Microsoft copyright in LICENSE; not archived). PyPI llguidance 1.9.1 verified 2026-11-09. Used as a fast backend for constrained decoding alongside the Guidance library. Model providers and host runtimes are separate.

agent_access.notes: Python package: pip install llguidance. Pair with guidance or other integrators as documented upstream.
